content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to SQL
    - Lesson 2: Creating, Altering, and Dropping Tables
    - Lesson 3: Understanding Data Types in SQL
    - Lesson 4: Basic CRUD Operations (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
    - Lesson 5: Introduction to Joins: INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN
    - Lesson 6: Working with Subqueries and Correlated Subqueries
    - Lesson 7: Understanding SQL Functions: CASE, COALESCE, IFNULL
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Transactions and Constraints
    - Lesson 9: Mastering Advanced Joins: OUTER APPLY, FULL OUTER JOIN, CARTESIAN JOIN
    - Lesson 10: Aggregations, Group By Clauses, and Window Functions

  Track: Data Cleaning with Python
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Pandas Data Structures
    - Lesson 2: Reading, Writing, and Manipulating CSV Files
    - Lesson 3: Handling Missing Values in Data
    - Lesson 4: Working with Datetime Objects
    - Lesson 5: Data Merging, Concatenation, and Joining
    - Lesson 6: Data Filtering, Sorting, and Grouping
    - Lesson 7: Data Reshaping and Pivoting Techniques
    - Lesson 8: Text Cleaning and Preprocessing Techniques

  Track: Intermediate Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Working with Libraries: NumPy, SciPy, StatsModels
    - Lesson 2: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and Data Visualization
    - Lesson 3: Statistical Testing and Hypothesis Testing
    - Lesson 4: Time Series Analysis with Pandas
    - Lesson 5: Regression Analysis with Scikit-learn
    - Lesson 6: Supervised Learning Algorithms (Linear Regression, Logistic Regression)
    - Lesson 7: Unsupervised Learning Techniques (Clustering and PCA)
    - Lesson 8: Introduction to Machine Learning Pipeline and Model Evaluation

  Track: Data Visualization with Matplotlib and Seaborn
    - Lesson 1: Creating Custom Plots with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 2: Bar Charts, Histograms, and Boxplots
    - Lesson 3: Line Charts, Area Charts, and Scatter Plots
    - Lesson 4: Heatmaps, Contour Plots, and 3D Plots
    - Lesson 5: Advanced Features in Matplotlib: Annotations, Grids, and Legends
    - Lesson 6: Introduction to Seaborn: Thematic Maps and Clustermaps
    - Lesson 7: Creating Interactive Plots with Bokeh and Plotly
    - Lesson 8: Building Advanced Dashboards using Dash by Plotly

  Track: Data Manipulation with Python (Advanced)
    - Lesson 1: Introducing dask for Large Datasets
    - Lesson 2: Parallel Processing and Memory Management in Pandas
    - Lesson 3: Working with SQLAlchemy to Connect to Databases
    - Lesson 4: Data ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) Workflows with Airflow
    - Lesson 5: Data Streaming with Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming
    - Lesson 6: Using BigQuery and Snowflake for Large-Scale Analytics
    - Lesson 7: Data Profiling and Quality Assessment with PyH2O and Databricks profiling
    - Lesson 8: Optimizing Data Manipulation Performance in Python

  Track: Introduction to Cloud-Based Data Processing (Google Cloud, AWS, Azure)
    - Lesson 1: Getting Started with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), and Microsoft Azure (MS Azure)
    - Lesson 2: Setting Up Data Storage: BigQuery, Redshift, Synapse Analytics
    - Lesson 3: Creating Data Pipelines with Apache Beam and DataFlow
    - Lesson 4: Working with Machine Learning Services: AutoML, TensorFlow, PyTorch
    - Lesson 5: Utilizing Serverless Functions: Cloud Functions, Lambda, Azure Functions
    - Lesson 6: Managing Resources, Cost Optimization, and Security
    - Lesson 7: Monitoring and Debugging with Cloud Monitoring and DataDog
    - Lesson 8: Collaborative Workspace for Data Teams: Google Colab, AWS SageMaker, Azure Notebooks
